summary: Under nightly has_specialisation, equal nonempty Single vectors with distinct chunk allocations compare unequal because cmp_chunk checks pointer identity. The fix retains that fast path and compares elements when identities differ. The existing iter_mut property compares independently allocated vectors containing identical incremented elements; the fix adds persisted regression seeds shrinking to 13-element inputs. Detection requires has_specialisation; the candidate's stable Rust 1.40.0 configuration does not exercise this bug. No tests were executed.
